Create a global map of endemic species

Source: R/endemicMap.R
endemicMap.Rd

Produces a global map of the number of species endemic to each botanical country, i.e. the species native to a single botanical country (level 3) of the World Geographical Scheme for Recording Plant Distributions. While powoMap maps where species occur, endemicMap maps where species are restricted to.

Usage

endemicMap(inputdf = NULL,
           distcol = "native_to_botanical_countries",
           breaks = c(10, 50, 100, 250, 500),
           leg_title = "Endemic species",
           verbose = TRUE,
           save = FALSE,
           dpi = 600,
           dir = "results_endemicMap",
           filename = "endemic_map",
           format = "jpg")

Arguments

inputdf

A data frame generated with powoSpecies, or any data frame with one species per row and a column with its native distribution in botanical countries separated by commas. When the input data has synonyms (status column), only accepted species are counted.

distcol

Column name with the native distribution in botanical countries. The default is the column native_to_botanical_countries returned by powoSpecies.

breaks

A numeric vector with the upper limits of the classes of endemic species shown in the map. Botanical countries without endemics and those with more endemics than the last limit are shown in their own classes. The default creates the classes 0, 1-10, 11-50, 51-100, 101-250, 251-500 and

leg_title

A character with the legend title.

verbose

Logical, if FALSE, a message showing each step will not be printed in the console.

save

Logical, if TRUE, the map will be saved on disk.

dpi

One number in the range of 72-4000 referring to the image resolution in dots per inch. The default is 600.

dir

Pathway to the computer's directory, where the map will be saved provided that the argument save is TRUE. The default is to create a directory named results_endemicMap and the map will be saved within a subfolder named after the current date.

filename

Name of the output file. The default is endemic_map.

format

The file format of the map: "jpg" (default), "pdf", "png" or "tiff".

Value

A ggplot object with the map, whose data has the number of endemic species of each botanical country in the column endemics. The TDWG map of botanical countries is downloaded only once and kept at tools::R_user_dir("expowo", "cache").

See also

powoMap

Author

Debora Zuanny & Domingos Cardoso

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(expowo)

fab <- powoSpecies("Fabaceae", verbose = FALSE)

endemicMap(fab,
           save = TRUE,
           dir = "results_endemicMap",
           filename = "Fabaceae_endemics")
} # }
